overview_description.description: Dcbel specializes in smart home energy systems that empower users to manage their energy supply through a single device.  The company utilizes AI and micro-weather forecasting to optimize energy use and prepare for outages by storing energy during off-peak times. Dcbel is also focusing on bidirectional DC fast charging for homes, allowing users to power their electric vehicles more efficiently.

product.name: Ara Core
product.description: A home energy station that connects to a bidirectional EV or home battery to provide backup power, energy management, DC EV charging, and participation in energy programs.

product.name: Ara Core with solar
product.description: A home energy station that combines solar generation, energy storage, bidirectional EV charging, and automated home energy management to reduce grid dependence and provide backup power.

product.name: dcbel App Hub
product.description: A marketplace of applications for managing Ara home energy systems, monitoring energy flows, and enrolling in utility, demand-response, virtual power plant, and vehicle-to-grid programs.

identifier.value: Private Grid Design and Installation Service

product.name: Private Grid Design and Installation Service
product.description: A residential energy-system design and deployment service that configures Ara equipment with solar panels, home batteries, EVs, and the utility grid for automated energy control and backup power.
